name: TOURIST_DRIVE_{n}_ROUTE_MARKER_BROWN

trb_arrow_up.desc: Upward arrow with a narrow shaft and a triangular head, 74 high on a 12 grid; 66 wide as the TRA arrow (the emblem picture and the grid detail both show the TRB arrow 66 wide; the 95 | 50 | 95 chain does not fit it).
trb_arrow_up.trace_note: TRB reuses TRA.png (the drawing shows both emblems; TRB has no PNG of its own) so the --spec tracer reports it as a reuse; traced with: trace_symbol.py --drawing TRA --ground brown --inset 0 --box 85 57 70 74 --size 240 240 --panel 554 186 658 292 --invert --id trb_arrow_up (crop widened to 70 because the drawn head is ~67 wide)

notes: TRB-1 (size 1) 240x240: pentagon as TRA (8 white border). Arrow 74 high, top at 57 (50 | 7 | 74 | 13 | 67 E | 29 = 240); its width is taken as 66 (87 | 66 | 87), as TRA: the emblem picture and the 12-grid detail both show the TRB arrow head 66 wide, and the traced outline is 67 x 74, so the 95 | 50 | 95 chain cannot be the arrow (a 67 E numeral is about 54 wide, so it may be the numeral's box - not used). Numeral 67 E white centred, cap top 144; varies 1-9.
